subject: Geografia
description_pt: Reconhecer e comparar atributos da qualidade ambiental e algumas formas de poluição dos cursos de água e dos oceanos (esgotos, efluentes industriais, marés negras etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar atributos usados para avaliar qualidade ambiental em corpos hídricos e oceanos
components.description_en: Identify attributes used to assess environmental quality in waterways and oceans

components.description_pt: Reconhecer diferentes formas de poluição afetando corpos hídricos e oceanos (esgoto, efluentes industriais, vazamentos de óleo)
components.description_en: Recognize different forms of pollution affecting waterways and oceans (sewage, industrial effluents, oil spills)
components.cc_component_description: Explain how habitat destruction, pollution, invasive species, overexploitation, or climate change affect biodiversity

components.description_pt: Comparar impactos ambientais de diferentes tipos de poluição hídrica em ecossistemas aquáticos
components.description_en: Compare the environmental impacts of different types of water pollution on aquatic ecosystems
components.cc_component_description: Compare the environmental effects of human activities with efforts to mitigate those effects

cc_matches.description: Moreover, anthropogenic changes (induced by human activity) in the environment—including habitat destruction, pollution, introduction of invasive species, overexploitation, and climate change—can disrupt an ecosystem and threaten the survival of some species.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
